# Drifti

> Capability contracts and drift detection for AI agents. Drifti learns what an agent needs, turns it into a reviewable contract, and detects when behavior drifts outside that contract. Authored by Luca Becci. v0.1 MVP: Linux `observe`/`verify` via ptrace; build the `drifti` CLI from source.

Drifti is a local-first Rust developer tool. It sits between observation and enforcement. It is not a coding agent, a sandbox, or a generic observability platform. The trust boundary is deterministic: an LLM may explain or propose, and must not approve capabilities or change a trusted contract.
